meta.name: Jaha Bolibo Shotto Bolibo
meta.description:
Public prosecutor Pritha Roy takes up the case of a police officer who is murdered on intervening in an eve-teasing incident. The accused are fellow officers, defended by top lawyer Joyraj Singha. As both lawyers try to prove a point, personal and professional twists threaten to engulf them both!

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/6 (missing E4)

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Pritha Roy dares to take up the case of IC Tapas Saha, who was murdered on New Year's Eve. The case has far-reaching consequences as the accused are fellow officers.

videos.title: Sinha Noy, Singha
videos.overview: Ajay Chatterjee appoints Pritha to take lead on the case after he suddenly falls ill. Turns out Pritha's opponent is the unyielding Joyraj Singha!

videos.title: Bike ta kothay
videos.overview: Joyraj deftly shifts the blame onto the late Tapas Saha's friends. Pritha's grip on the case starts to loosen.

videos.title: Shobai bikri hoy
videos.overview: As the police become desperate to track the victim of the eve-teasing incident from that night, Joyraj's vulnerable conversation with Pritha gives way to a startling revelation.

videos.title: Golpo holeyo shotti
videos.overview: Pritha stands in the confession box to reveal a dark truth from that night. Amidst the blurring lines of good and bad, will justice prevail to restore faith in the police?
